$ ast agent pause --name probe-gw
  Pausing probe-gw
  probe-gw paused

$ ast agent get --name probe-gw
  probe-gw  <account>
    Status:     Stopped
    Reason:     Deployment is paused
    Environment: main
    Build:      <build-id>

$ ast agent resume --name probe-gw
  Resuming probe-gw
  probe-gw resumed

$ ast agent get --name probe-gw
  probe-gw  <account>
    Status:     pending
    Reason:     Waiting for workloads to become ready
    Environment: main
    Build:      <build-id>

  (a later read showed Status: Running again; see 03-agent-get.txt)
